value.rationale: A fixed local L2 projection is standard DG preprocessing for discontinuity-bearing data. Its exact BV-to-L1 integrated error norm is a natural stability/accuracy budget, not an arbitrary slice. The sharp two off-centre jump phases, unexpected slight excess over 1/4, and mesh-independent longest-cell law identify worst shock alignment and enable exact cell-size error control. Piecewise constants have sharp 1/2 coefficient, so the affine projector gives a quantified accuracy change.
